name: Max Tagher
current_role: Co-founder and CTO, Mercury (Mercury Technologies Inc.)
profile: Max Tagher co-founded San Francisco fintech Mercury in 2017 with Immad Akhund and Jason Zhang and serves as its CTO. Mercury offers banking services to startups and small businesses through partner banks and was valued at about $5.2B as of 2026.
interesting_fact: Mercury's entire backend is written in Haskell, an unusual choice for a startup; Tagher says Haskell's correctness suited building the core features of a bank, and that backend Haskell engineer is the company's 'easiest role to hire for'.
deep_cut_fact: Tagher credits Michael Snoyman's open-source Yesod and Persistent libraries, saying Mercury 'would have never used Haskell if not for his work'; he personally tries to sponsor the OSS authors of the ~194 packages Mercury depends on.
notes: Engineering-focused, low public profile compared with CEO Immad Akhund; Haskell/engineering angle is the natural hook.
